races.name: Peroni Nastro Azzurro 0.0% Handicap

runners_data.name: Colori Forever
runners_data.note: Hold-up style faces major tactical disadvantage against confirmed front runners, needs pace collapse to be competitive
runners_data.comment: Impressive winner on AW comeback; creditable 2nd under penalty since; now 6lb higher
runners_data.spotlight: Impressive winner over 7f on Southwell AW reappearance; made favourite for a good 7f Newbury handicap since, when 6lb well in under a penalty, but failed to get into the action soon enough, finishing second to a more prominently ridden winner (May Angel just behind); still has potential despite running off his new mark and this stiff 7f can suit.

runners_data.name: May Angel
runners_data.note: Powerful closer with strong recent form but requires significant pace pressure to unleash finishing kick from rear
runners_data.comment: Won 7f AW novice as 2yo; good 3rd in well-contested 7f Newbury handicap on return; solid
runners_data.spotlight: Ready winner of 7f novice on Southwell AW before highly tried in Group races on final 2yo starts; gelded and had wind surgery in the close season and returned with a useful effort to be third in a well-contested Newbury handicap (7f, good; just behind the penalised Colori Forever) last month; looks sure to be involved off the same mark.

runners_data.name: Angel Of Anfield
runners_data.note: Natural front runner returning from 212-day break, may lack peak fitness but tactical advantage is clear
runners_data.comment: All races at sprint trips, making all at Windsor in August; good AW run after; off since
runners_data.spotlight: All turf races at sprint trips on good to firm and good, vigorously ridden when making all at Windsor last August from one who went on to better things; a similarly useful effort when runner-up on Kempton AW in October but he lacks a recent run and has a new trip to contend with.

runners_data.name: Albaydaa
runners_data.note: Consistent lead-or-prominent style with solid recent Newmarket third, ideally positioned for this pace scenario
runners_data.comment: Won 7f AW maiden on final 2yo start; staying-on 3rd in 6f Newmarket handicap latest
runners_data.spotlight: Came on plenty for each 2yo run, making all in a 7f maiden on Wolverhampton AW in November; plenty to like about her reappearance in a 6f handicap at Newmarket (good) recently, where she initially failed to pick up but came home nicely to finish a close third of 13; should come on for the run and go well back over 7f; yard has won three of the last seven runnings.

runners_data.name: Goldwork
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse moving up in class, excellent recent Lingfield win but wrong tactical profile for this race shape

runners_data.name: Ay Up Duck
runners_data.note: Prominent racer improving with experience, perfectly positioned to benefit from front runners' pace pressure
runners_data.comment: Forged clear on Southwell AW (7f) latest; faces a tough start to handicaps on turf debut
runners_data.spotlight: Unraced as a 2yo; improving with racing and he forged clear when getting off the mark on Southwell AW (back at 7f) recently; should progress further but he's taking on rivals who have already shown their mettle in turf handicaps and this is a tough start to his career on grass.

runners_data.name: Queen Tamara
runners_data.note: Front-prominent style suits perfectly, returning from long break but proven 7f form at this level
runners_data.comment: Smart run from the front when dividing subsequent Listed/Group winners on final 2yo start
runners_data.spotlight: Won 7f Chepstow maiden, then ran a stormer from the front in a 7f Newmarket handicap (good to firm) last September where she tended to change direction under pressure but showed no lack of fight in dividing subsequent Listed and Group-race winners; promising but this may be needed.

runners_data.name: Aqua Bear
runners_data.note: Prominent style gives tactical edge, gelded since last run but faces fitness concerns after 167-day absence
runners_data.comment: Gelded since winning AW maiden in November on stable debut; needs progress to follow up
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-Irish runner who has been absent and gelded since justifying favouritism in Newcastle maiden (7f, AW) in November on stable debut; needs progress to follow up but market support should be heeded.

runners_data.name: Illy's Roo
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse faces significant tactical challenge, recent Newbury run suggests current form below best
runners_data.comment: All 3 wins at 7f, on turf/AW; recent Newbury defeat suggests another uphill battle awaits
runners_data.spotlight: All three wins over 7f, on turf and the AW, the latest on his yard debut in March; however, he's high in the weights now and his recent Newbury run (7f; 50-1) suggests another uphill battle awaits.

runners_data.name: Synners Kid
runners_data.note: Versatile hold-up horse with stamina questions at 7f, 218-day break compounds tactical disadvantage
runners_data.comment: Won both 1m handicaps for J O'Brien in the autumn; sold 110,000gns since; conditions query
runners_data.spotlight: Greatly improved for the step up to 1m and switch to handicaps on final two starts for Joseph O'Brien, winning both attempts (yielding to soft/soft) last autumn; sold for 110,000gns since and gelded; has very different conditions today and goes without his regular tongue-tie.

races.paceDynamic: Angel Of Anfield and Albaydaa will set a genuine gallop from the gates, with both confirmed front runners likely to dispute the early lead over this straight 7f at Ascot. Their pace pressure will stretch the field and create opportunities for those racing prominently like Ay Up Duck, Queen Tamara and Aqua Bear to sit close and strike. The strong early tempo will expose the hold-up horses who face a tactical disadvantage having to make up significant ground in the straight. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those who can sit handy rather than the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the front runners duel and weaken in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The pace collapse allows horses sitting in second or third to inherit the lead and maintain their momentum to the line. Those racing handy avoid the traffic and ground-making problems that will plague the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets a soft lead or breaks clear
scenarios.body: Angel Of Anfield or Albaydaa dominates by getting first run and maintaining their advantage to the line. The tactical pace battle becomes less important than pure speed and stamina reserves.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is particularly strong and collapses dramatically
scenarios.body: The front runners tie up badly in the final 1f, creating a gap for the strongest finisher to sweep through. Only the most potent closer can overcome the significant tactical disadvantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Compromised Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the front runners go too slow or one pulls up early
scenarios.body: The tactical battle becomes muddled with horses changing positions mid-race, creating unpredictable traffic patterns. Form horses with versatile racing styles can adapt better than specialists.

watchPoints.text: Angel Of Anfield and Albaydaa both break fast - if they go too hard early both could collapse and gift race to prominent runners
May Angel and Colori Forever need significant pace pressure up front to unleash their finishing kicks from rear positions
Ay Up Duck sits perfectly placed in second or third to inherit when front runners weaken in final furlong
Queen Tamara returning from 223-day break may need race despite ideal tactical position for this pace scenario
Aqua Bear's 167-day absence and gelding operation could impact fitness levels despite favorable running style

races.name: Juddmonte EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB)

runners_data.name: Big Hitter
runners_data.comment: February foal by Starspangledbanner; 65,000euros yearling; paper appeal so watch betting
runners_data.spotlight: Early February foal by Starspangledbanner; 65,000euros yearling; first foal; dam 6f 2yo winner (including Group 2; RPR 100), half-sister to winners Oliver Hardy (1m2f/1m4f) and Dajla (Spanish 1m-1m3f), out of maiden sister to 6f/7f 2yo Group 2 winner Strategic Prince, family of Oaks winner Ramruma; first juvenile runner of the year for her yard and holds appeal on pedigree; market a likely guide.

runners_data.name: Resemblance
runners_data.comment: March foal by first-season sire Bayside Boy, already 2-5; £45,000 yearling; likely type
runners_data.spotlight: Late March foal by first-season sire Bayside Boy, who is already 2-5; £45,000 yearling; seventh foal; half-sister to winners Significantly (Listed-placed 5f/6f including 2yo/AW; RPR 111), Salvuccio (5f/6f including 2yo/AW; 103) and Dutch Finale (6f AW; 80); dam Group-placed 5f/6f 2yo winner (97); has appeal on paper and betting should reveal more on this debut.

runners_data.name: Wondervision
runners_data.comment: Late March foal; 50,000gns yearling; yard already 2-5 with 2yos this year; watch market
runners_data.spotlight: Fairly late March foal by first-season sire Minzaal; 50,000gns yearling; fourth foal; half-sister to Listed-placed 7f AW 2yo winner Whip Cracker (RPR 103); dam once-raced half-sister to winners Advanced (smart 6f-7f) and Wunder (1m1f Group 3), out of German 7f winner; yard is already 2-5 with juveniles this year so interesting to see how she fares in the market ahead of this introduction.

runners_data.name: Half A Hoof
runners_data.comment: Fairly late March foal by Lucky Vega; 31,000euros yearling; betting should be a good guide
runners_data.spotlight: Fairly late March foal by Lucky Vega; 31,000euros yearling; eighth foal; half-sister to four winners including Fullness Of Life (Italian 6f-1m including 2yo/Group 3; RPR 99) and Sopran Brescia (Italian 1m1f-1m3f); dam Italian 6f 2yo winner, half-sister to HK 1m Group 1 winner Gentlemen Only; betting should be a good guide to expectations ahead of her debut.

runners_data.name: Magnesium
runners_data.comment: Late January foal by Ubettabelieveit; £30,000 yearling; yard has low 2yo turf strike-rate
runners_data.spotlight: Late January foal by Ubettabelieveit; £30,000 yearling; seventh foal; closely related to 5f winner I'm Next (including 2yo/AW; RPR 86), half-sister to winners Estepona Sun (7f AW 2yo/1m2f turf; 89) and Gundogan (6f; 77); dam unraced; yard has a low strike-rate on turf with its 2yos over the last five years; still worth a check of the betting on this debut.

runners_data.name: Romidijo
runners_data.comment: March foal by Ardad; 32,000euros yearling; market clues should be heeded on debut
runners_data.spotlight: March foal by Ardad; 32,000euros yearling; first foal; dam 5f/6f winner (including 2yo; RPR 94), half-sister to 1m 2yo winner Orgetorix, out of 5f winning half-sister to 5f Listed winner Stern Opinion; has the pedigree to make a juvenile and market clues should be heeded.

runners_data.name: Tallahassee Lassie
runners_data.comment: February foal by Tasleet; 38,000gns yearling; yard's 2yos generally improve for a run
runners_data.spotlight: February foal by Tasleet; 38,000gns yearling; fifth foal; half-sister to winners Paborus (Group-placed 7f including AW; RPR 117) and Sixteen Tons (French 1m5f); dam 5f/6f winner (91), half-sister to HK 7f winner Ka Ying Excellent, out of 7f/1m winner; yard's 2yos generally improve for a run but still needs monitoring in the betting.

runners_data.name: Summer Triangle
runners_data.comment: Late January foal by Land Force; yard not noted for winning 2yo newcomers
runners_data.spotlight: Late January foal by Land Force; dam 1m/1m2f winner (RPR 69), half-sister to 5f 2yo Group 3 winner Armor, out of useful French 1m winner; yard not noted for winning 2yo newcomers but worth a market check.

runners_data.name: Bint Archange
runners_data.comment: 4-1 when third in traditionally warm event (5f, good) last month; sets a clear standard
runners_data.spotlight: Early March sixth foal who is a half-sister to four winners; 45,000euros yearling; 4-1 for her debut when third of eight in a traditionally warm event at Newmarket (5f, good) last month; sets a clear standard on that form.

runners_data.name: Dee's Star
runners_data.comment: Sixth of 13 (5f, good) on debut; no certainty to beat Past Passion or Miss Moneypit again
runners_data.spotlight: Fairly late January foal who showed ability when sixth of 13 at Bath (5f, good; 25-1) on her debut three weeks ago; respected but she's no certainty to confirm placings with Past Passion or Miss Moneypit, who were just a head and a head behind.

runners_data.name: Miss Moneypit
runners_data.comment: Early January foal; nibbled in market before luckless debut; big contender to step forward
runners_data.spotlight: Early January foal who was nibbled at in the betting when 12-1 but suffered a luckless debut when eighth at Bath (5f, good; Dee's Star sixth, Past Passion seventh) three weeks ago; yard introduced five-time winning juvenile Anthelia (including Listed National Stakes, Super Sprint and Group 3 Dick Poole) in that race last year; big contender to do better this time.

runners_data.name: Past Passion
runners_data.comment: Missed break when finishing alongside Dee's Star and Miss Moneypit on debut; can improve
runners_data.spotlight: April foal who was 18-1 when missing the break and finishing seventh at Bath (5f, good; Dee's Star a head in front, Miss Moneypit a head behind) on her debut three weeks ago; contender to step forward on this second start.

runners_data.name: Beautiful Rainbow
runners_data.comment: April foal; 11-2 when fifth of nine at Beverley (5f, good) 15 days ago; should do better
runners_data.spotlight: Early April foal who was 11-2 for her first go when fifth of nine at Beverley (5f, good) a fortnight ago; displayed inexperience that day before looking to get the message late; should do better.

races.name: Palmer & Co. Champagne Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Antiquarian
runners_data.comment: Finished remote at Newmarket (6f) on sole 2yo start; trip query on pedigree; lots to find
runners_data.spotlight: Finished a remote last of five runners at Newmarket (6f; 66-1) on sole 2yo run; not sure to stay this far on pedigree and ordinary handicaps are likely to be the aim; has lots to prove.

runners_data.name: Bintknight
runners_data.comment: 200,000gns foal; useful pedigree; trainer has fair strike-rate in maidens; may need this
runners_data.spotlight: 200,000gns foal; sixth foal; by Pinatubo; winning siblings include 1m2f AW winner Queen Of The Skies (RPR 100) and Cape Breton (1m AW 2yo/1m4f turf; 94); dam 1m winner (97), half-sister to 1m4f Group 2 winner Frankly Darling; trainer has fair strike-rate in maidens but this run may be needed.

runners_data.name: Cool Girl
runners_data.comment: 100,000euros yearling; out of half-sister to Group 1 winner in Hong Kong; market helpful
runners_data.spotlight: 100,000euros yearling; second foal; by Pinatubo; dam twice-raced (runner-up at 1m4f; RPR 76) half-sister to winners Pakistan Star (Hong Kong 1m2f/1m4f Group 1) and Ninas Terz (useful German 6f 2yo); market can guide.

runners_data.name: Tarrant
runners_data.comment: Promising 3rd of 11 on Newbury debut (7f); very likely to improve; major contender
runners_data.spotlight: Dam's winning offspring include 1m1f Group 3 winner Viareggio; little market interest in her before recent Newbury debut (7f, good) but she held a good position throughout when third of 11; hard to assess the worth of that newcomers' race but she should come on for the run; major contender.

runners_data.name: Light Of Paris
runners_data.comment: 500,000gns yearling; well-bred 3yo but she finished remote on AW debut (1m3f)
runners_data.spotlight: 500,000gns yearling; out of Listed winner whose successful offspring include Group 1 and Listed winners, but this one made a low-key start on Kempton AW (1m3f; 6-1) last month when dropping right out; ought to have some potential but major step forward is a must.

runners_data.name: Gone By
runners_data.comment: Promising 2nd to smart stablemate at Newbury (1m, soft) in sole 2yo start; interesting
runners_data.spotlight: 140,000euros yearling; unraced dam's winning siblings included a Listed winner at 1m5f; easy to back on Newbury debut (1m, soft) in October but she was the only one to make a race of it with a promising stablemate (finished third in the Cheshire Oaks on Wednesday), looking decidedly less wised up than the winner; interesting on return.

runners_data.name: Pierpoint
runners_data.comment: 33-1, hinted at ability on Newbury debut (7f) but 5l behind stablemate Tarrant
runners_data.spotlight: 33-1 for recent Newbury debut over 7f where she never threatened to play a part but nevertheless hinted at ability, albeit 5l behind stablemate Tarrant; open to some improvement, probably when handicapping.

runners_data.name: Salamis Bay
runners_data.comment: Just minor promise in ordinary 6f races on AW this year but there is stamina on dam's side
runners_data.spotlight: Minor promise in ordinary 6f races on the AW this year and although there's stamina on the dam's side of the pedigree she does have a lot to find on the bare results.

races.name: Only Peroni Nastro Azzurro 0.0% Handicap

runners_data.name: Toyotomi
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who needs things to fall right from his draw and hasn't shown his best form for 25 days
runners_data.comment: Listed winner in France (about 5f; has won at 1m); likely strong pace will suit
runners_data.spotlight: First three French wins came at about 1m but better form when winning a Listed race at about 5f last April; took time to find his feet for this yard but he couldn't get out of a scrum at Goodwood (6f, good) in October and ran well for a long way on Newcastle AW last month; the likely strong pace will suit and he has a good run in him.

runners_data.name: Mandurah
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 204-day break but showed class when leading long at this course as a 2yo
runners_data.comment: Good to firm suits; useful C&D form in Group 3 as a 2yo; new yard; interesting
runners_data.spotlight: Winning 2yo debut was followed by a stout effort in a Group 3 over C&D (also good to firm) when leading from some way out and looked like holding on but couldn't quite sustain her effort; has rarely had her ground since but she ran well against an improver on AW (7f) in October on final start for the Crisfords; sold for 150,000gns; she might well have a good 4yo season.

runners_data.name: Bolo Neighs
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner in consistent form but needs a strong pace to be effective over this sharp 6f trip

runners_data.name: Brosay
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner wearing blinkers for the first time which could help his tactical positioning
runners_data.comment: Two 6f wins last summer, including C&D; had excuses for heavy defeats for new yard
runners_data.spotlight: Two 6f wins at the end of last summer, at Windsor (good to firm) and over C&D (good to soft); just 2lb higher than for the latter but he's hard to assess now, having been well held over an inadequate 5f on his yard debut (AW) then eased following serious interference at Newbury; too much to prove just now but one to keep an eye on.

runners_data.name: Saint Lawrence
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with a tendency to fade in the finish and returning from a long 218-day absence
runners_data.comment: Won the Wokingham over C&D in 2023; struggling now but well treated for new yard
runners_data.spotlight: Hit the handicap heights when winning the Wokingham over C&D in 2023 on debut for Archie Watson, then close up in the Group 1 Maurice de Gheest; desperately hard to place in handicaps since but he's had wind surgery since last seen in October and, even at this late stage, he might well turn it on for Kevin Ryan off a 17lb lower mark than at the start of last year.

runners_data.name: Elements Of Fire
runners_data.note: Front runner stepping back to 6f from 7f but has tactical speed and Hollie Doyle's excellent positioning skills
runners_data.comment: 3-3 over 7f on AW for new yard; acts on turf; no surprise if he goes well in first 6f run
runners_data.spotlight: Has done really well front-running over 7f on the AW for new yard, winning all three starts; has more to prove up another 5lb and dropped to 6f on the return to turf but he's perfectly capable of giving it a good shot on grass, having run well under a penalty in a good novice at Doncaster last spring.

runners_data.name: Photosynthesis
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who won narrowly last time and should benefit from the likely pace setup
runners_data.comment: Four wins, the latest for this yard at Newmarket (6f, good); needs extra in higher grade
runners_data.spotlight: Three wins for two previous yards and the first for this one when winning narrowly at Newmarket (6f, good) in September, following a protracted slog with the runner-up; comes here fit from the AW but he'll need a bit extra to win in a higher grade than at Newmarket.

runners_data.name: Betsen
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning to turf after AW campaigns and only 13 days since last run
runners_data.comment: Fair turf form in Ireland; kept mostly to AW of late; badly hampered back on turf latest
runners_data.spotlight: Quite useful on turf in Ireland; kept almost entirely to AW since moving to this yard in the autumn but he might well have been involved in the finish at Leicester (6f, good to firm) two weeks ago but for being pushed nearly over the rail a furlong out; interesting to see what he comes up with here.

runners_data.name: Kodiac Thriller
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with excellent recent Ripon form and Silvestre De Sousa's tactical expertise
runners_data.comment: Best form at Ripon, 2nd in their top handicap last August, then won there latest
runners_data.spotlight: Had a good season for new yard in 2025, winning on second start and running two excellent races at Ripon when returned to 6f, notably when first home on his side in the Great St Wilfrid (good to firm) in August; confirmed his liking for that course when winning there three weeks ago and needs to prove he's the same horse elsewhere.

runners_data.name: Walson's Law
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from 280-day layoff but showed improvement when switching yards
runners_data.comment: Won first 2 turf starts for the yard, over 1m and 7f; off since August; trip query over 6f
runners_data.spotlight: Winless for previous yard but he won his first two turf starts for this one in 2025, over 1m at Windsor and 7f at Newbury (both on good to firm); it's possible that good to soft ground proved his undoing when last seen in August but a layoff since raises questions as does the return to 6f.

runners_data.name: Hucklesbrook
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose form dipped after early-season wins but has proven course form
runners_data.comment: Just 2lb higher than for the second of two 6f wins in 2025; ran well on return; claims
runners_data.spotlight: Ran well on C&D return in 2025 before winning his next two over 6f, at Leicester (good to firm; made all) and York; his form took a downward turn after but his recent Newbury fourth was a step in the right direction and he's only 2lb higher than for the York win; looks good for a prominent show.

races.paceDynamic: Elements Of Fire will dominate the early pace as the sole confirmed front runner, with Mandurah, Photosynthesis, Kodiac Thriller and Hucklesbrook likely to track just behind in prominent positions. The sustainable pace created by Elements Of Fire's uncontested lead will allow the prominent runners to stay in touch without excessive energy expenditure. This shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed, as they can position perfectly behind the leader and strike when ready, while the numerous hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground in a steadily-run race.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Elements Of Fire sets manageable fractions and the prominent pack stays close
scenarios.body: The tactical runners get first jump on the leader turning for home and sustain their challenge better than the hold-up horses who face too much to do. Mandurah and Photosynthesis are perfectly positioned to exploit this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Elements Of Fire maintains his strong all-weather form and gets away with soft sectionals
scenarios.body: The leader kicks clear at the two-furlong pole and holds off all challengers, with the best of the prominent runners chasing home. His three consecutive wins suggest he has the tactical nous to control this field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely pedestrian and creates a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks and overhaul the prominent group in the final furlong. Toyotomi and Brosay benefit most from this compressed finish scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Elements Of Fire goes too fast early or gets pressured by the prominent pack
scenarios.body: The race becomes truly-run and several horses hit the front in the final 100 yards, with stamina and class prevailing over tactics. This suits horses with proven Group-level form who can grind out victories.

watchPoints.text: Elements Of Fire could get an uncontested lead and prove very hard to peg back if allowed soft sectionals
Mandurah returning from 204 days off but this course suits his style and he has class on his side
Saint Lawrence tends to fade in the finish and the long absence makes him vulnerable despite his past course success
Brosay wears blinkers for the first time which could sharpen his early tactical positioning
Watch for Kodiac Thriller to get a perfect stalking position behind Elements Of Fire under De Sousa's guidance

races.name: Ascot Hospitality Handicap

runners_data.name: Sizzling Seixas
runners_data.note: Front-runner facing much tougher task than previous make-all win in small field
runners_data.comment: Just two starts and won latest (6f, AW); firmly in the picture on h'cap/turf debut
runners_data.spotlight: Stepped up on her debut in March when making all in five-runner novice at Kempton (also 6f, AW) three weeks later; those tactics will be tough to repeat in this field but she brings plenty of potential into this turf and handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Secret Santa
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with strong form on good going and 336 days off could be primed
runners_data.comment: Disappointed when last seen; Newbury third a year ago makes him fascinating on h'cap debut
runners_data.spotlight: All starts on good; beaten under 3l by subsequent Windsor Castle winner on 5f debut last May then finished third to subsequent Chesham winner at Newbury (6f) a fortnight later; latter event worked out extremely well so disappointing he couldn't get the job done at Bath (odds-on) the following month; not seen since but good chance of making a successful handicap debut/reappearance if ready and tapping back into that initial promise.

runners_data.name: Night Mission
runners_data.note: Gelded hold-up horse who stayed on well last time and suits strong pace
runners_data.comment: Stuck on from rear when fifth to Arry Up (6f, AW) on reappearance/h'cap debut a month ago
runners_data.spotlight: Clear ability when placed all three starts (6f, good/good to soft) at two; gelded and stuck on from the rear when fifth to Arry Up at Kempton (6f, AW) on reappearance/handicap debut one month ago; will need to have come on for the outing but that's not beyond the realms.

runners_data.name: Ballybunion
runners_data.note: Hold-up merchant returning from 207-day break with solid placed form on good
runners_data.comment: Runner-up twice (also 6f, good) last term; gelded ahead of this return/handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Good step forward from debut when runner-up at Ripon, albeit beaten 5l in four-runner event, in September and backed that up when second again at Yarmouth (also 6f, good) the following month; has been gelded and interesting to see how he goes in the market ahead of this reappearance/handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Hallo Spaceboy
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner who stumbled at start last time but has winning form
runners_data.comment: Second to Arry Up (AW) latest; acts on turf and shouldn't be far away from same mark
runners_data.spotlight: Consistent in four starts, including win at Newcastle (5f) in November and when second to Arry Up at Kempton (6f, also AW; stumbled start) on handicap debut/reappearance one month ago; acts on turf and shouldn't be far away from same mark.

runners_data.name: Duskaura
runners_data.note: All five-furlong form may struggle with this pace over six furlongs
runners_data.comment: All starts at 5f; form of three AW h'caps suggest extra furlong needs to give a fair boost
runners_data.spotlight: All starts at 5f; no impact in two Listed races after winning Ripon fillies' maiden (good) for Archie Watson last term; sights lowered for this yard but form of three handicap runs on Wolverhampton's AW suggest this extra furlong will need to give her quite the boost.

runners_data.name: Afton Down
runners_data.note: Improved winner last time but handicap debut on turf is significant step up
runners_data.comment: Won novice (6f, AW) on return; sound turf no issue and he's respected on handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Small step forward when comfortably winning Wolverhampton novice (6f, AW) on his return three weeks ago; will need more again on this handicap debut but that's by no means unlikely and he ran well on quick turf in October; respected.

runners_data.name: Star Of Albion
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with blinkers who didn't beat much when winning in January
runners_data.comment: No show in classy affair in February but return to turf should be no problem
runners_data.spotlight: Went close on handicap debut in September; odds-on but still improved on fifth start to win Lingfield novice (6f, AW; first-time blinkers) in January; didn't back that up when down the field in classy affair over that C&D one month later but return to turf should be no problem.

runners_data.name: Blue Orbit
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with respectable handicap form but 21 days since last run
runners_data.comment: Solid second on comeback and didn't have the cleanest shot latest; not ruled out
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark on second start (5f, good to firm) and ran respectably on handicap debut when beaten 3l at Glorious Goodwood (6f, good to soft; not clear run) in August; gelded before sharing second (5f, AW) on reappearance in March and again didn't have the cleanest shot when fourth at Bath one month later; not ruled out.

runners_data.name: Rogue Temptation
runners_data.note: Prominent type wearing cheekpieces but finished last twice recently on all-weather
runners_data.comment: Reappearance fifth wasn't a bad effort three weeks ago; needs to build on that
runners_data.spotlight: Haydock novice (6f, good) winner who made pleasing handicap debut when third of 12 at Doncaster (6.5f, good to soft) in September; finished last on final two starts of last year but reappearance fifth of 13 at Ripon (6f, good to soft; first-time blinkers) wasn't a bad effort three weeks ago; now needs to build on that.

runners_data.name: Moscow Power
runners_data.note: Gelded before just managing win last time and faces much stronger field
runners_data.comment: Promising debut and justified short price on return (6f, AW); fair mark for h'cap debut
runners_data.spotlight: All starts at 6f; best of two runs last term came when chasing home two smart Godolphin juveniles on debut at Haydock (good to firm) last May; gelded before justifying a shade of odds-on at Chelmsford (also 6f, AW) on return in March; should do better again and this mark looks fair ahead of his handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Fair Y Isle
runners_data.note: All-weather specialist making turf debut in much tougher company
runners_data.comment: Just held on h'cap debut (6f, AW); 2lb nudge demands more but still not ruled out
runners_data.spotlight: All starts on AW; picked up Wolverhampton fillies' novice in January and just held at Southwell (also 6f) on her handicap debut last month; this is tougher and a 2lb nudge demands more; still not ruled out.

runners_data.name: Wedonttelllies
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with William Buick booking but disappointing in handicaps
runners_data.comment: Only fifth on h'cap debut last term but comeback can be ignored & William Buick takes over
runners_data.spotlight: Beat 13 others to land Kempton novice (AW) in September but only fifth when favourite for handicap debut at Newmarket (also 7f, good to firm) the following month; subsequently gelded and his comeback run at Bath (5.5f, good but almost certainly softer) can be written off; booking of William Buick (1-4 for yard this season at start of the day) catches the eye.

runners_data.name: Dublin Bay
runners_data.note: Front-runner with first-time cheekpieces who just held on in weaker company
runners_data.comment: Won 3rd h'cap (7f, AW) last time; these conditions no problem but 4lb rise might be
runners_data.spotlight: More exposed than most but he won third handicap when making all at Wolverhampton (7f, AW; just held on) four weeks ago; also won twice at 6f on sound turf so these conditions should be no problem, but a 4lb rise might be.

runners_data.name: Who Is Alice
runners_data.note: Front-runner returning from 192-day break after inconsistent nursery campaign
runners_data.comment: 0-5 in handicaps; new yard going well but she'll need to bring her A-game to this return
runners_data.spotlight: Looked sure to progress in nurseries after winning Chepstow maiden (7f, good to firm) in July so it was disappointing she went 0-5 when inconsistent in that sphere subsequently; left Jack Channon (same owners) after finishing last at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) in October; new yard going well but she'll need to bring her A-game to this return.

runners_data.name: Twilight Glow
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who was gelded and showed improvement at Kempton last time
runners_data.comment: Not disgraced when fourth (7f, AW; 25-1) on return last month; needs to build on that
runners_data.spotlight: Second of 12 at Newbury (6f, only start on good to soft) was much the best of four runs last year; gelded and not disgraced when fourth at Kempton (7f, AW; 25-1) on his reappearance at the start of last month; needs to build on that.

runners_data.name: Empress Olivia
runners_data.note: Prominent runner coming off good handicap win and handles good going well
runners_data.comment: Won 6f Ripon handicap three weeks ago; not ruled out despite 5lb rise
runners_data.spotlight: 28-1 winner of Ripon maiden (6f, good) in August and built on close reappearance second when beating 12 others in handicap over that C&D (good to soft) three weeks ago; evidently likes that track but has form elsewhere and she's not ruled out despite 5lb rise.

runners_data.name: Arry Up
runners_data.note: Unbeaten in handicaps and prominent style suits this pace setup perfectly
runners_data.comment: Big boy who's firmly on the up; landed hat-trick latest and fancied to complete four-timer
runners_data.spotlight: Fine stamp who is unbeaten since contesting handicaps; made all to land his third such race when defying penalty to score at Kempton (6f, AW; Hallo Spaceboy second, Night Mission fifth) one month ago; also won on turf (good to soft, acts on good) and doesn't have to lead; impossible to ignore in current mood.

runners_data.name: Bellini Spirit
runners_data.note: Front-runner with limited ability who was second once in four career starts
runners_data.comment: Best run came at 6f but maiden/h'cap form for this yard leaves her with work to do
runners_data.spotlight: Four starts, one each at 5f, 6f, 7f and 1m; best form by some way when second over this trip at Chelmsford (AW; 40-1) on second go for Anthony Carson, which could be a straw to clutch at, but form in a maiden and handicap for this yard leaves her with work to do.

runners_data.name: Red Snapper
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare with 3lb apprentice claim but modest overall form profile
runners_data.comment: Improved in cheekpieces and solid second on return; should run his race again back at 6f
runners_data.spotlight: Last three starts at Bath and went close there (5.5f, good to firm; first-time cheekpieces) in September; narrowly off the mark (5f, heavy) the following month and handled the rise in grade well when second (5.5f, good; kept on) on his comeback three weeks ago; return to 6f unlikely to represent a problem and should run his race again.

races.paceDynamic: Sizzling Seixas, Dublin Bay, Who Is Alice and Bellini Spirit will ensure a strong early gallop with four confirmed front-runners in a 20-runner field. The prominent brigade of Hallo Spaceboy, Blue Orbit, Rogue Temptation, Moscow Power, Fair Y Isle, Empress Olivia and Arry Up creates dangerous mid-race congestion as they jostle for position behind the leaders. This sustained pace will set up perfectly for the hold-up merchants to swoop late when the early pace collapses. The strong gallop over 6f at Ascot heavily favours closers and hold-up horses who can unleash their finishing kick.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Capitalize Late
scenarios.trigger: If the four leaders go too fast early and fade in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will crack the front-runners and prominent runners, leaving the race to the patient hold-up horses who can quicken off the strong gallop. Night Mission, Secret Santa and Star Of Albion are perfectly positioned to exploit this pace collapse.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong but sustainable, creating perfect stalking conditions
scenarios.body: The prominent brigade can track the leaders without over-racing and have enough left to strike in the final quarter-mile when the pace-setters weaken. Hallo Spaceboy and Arry Up are best placed to benefit from this tactical position.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one pace-setter gets loose and dictates moderate fractions while the others struggle
scenarios.body: Dublin Bay or Sizzling Seixas could steal a march if they can break clear of the other leaders and slow the tempo down. This would prevent the closers from mounting their usual late charge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Mid-Division Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is so fierce that both leaders and prominent runners fold completely
scenarios.body: The chaos up front allows a mid-field runner to thread through and capitalize on the carnage ahead. This would require a perfectly timed move from a horse who avoided the early battles.

watchPoints.text: Sizzling Seixas and Dublin Bay could clash for the early lead and compromise each other's chances
Blue Orbit and Moscow Power both return after three weeks off which could blunt their finishing kicks
Arry Up has won three straight handicaps and William Buick choosing Wedonttelllies over other options is notable
The prominent group of eight horses will create serious traffic problems turning into the straight
Secret Santa returning from 336 days off for powerful Hannon yard could be underestimated by market

races.name: Peroni Nastro Azzurro 0.0% Style Handicap

runners_data.name: Spirit Of Saxony
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse perfectly suited to a strong gallop, 20 days since last run should have him primed
runners_data.comment: Prominent throughout when fifth of 25 in 1m Newbury maiden last month; handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in novice races on first two starts (6f/7f) and again displayed clear promise when fifth of 25 in Newbury maiden (1m, good) last month, racing prominently throughout; likely contender on handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Blue Courvoisier
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with proven form at this trip, raced too freely last time but has clear class advantage
runners_data.comment: Creditable second on seasonal/handicap debut at Newmarket and only 1lb higher here
runners_data.spotlight: Won 7f Leicester novice in September and was creditable second on last month's seasonal/handicap debut at Newmarket (1m, good), despite racing a bit too freely; that form has recently been well advertised by the third and this fellow is probably still on a good mark after 1lb nudge.

runners_data.name: Outback Heat
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner who can dictate, though 27-day break and moderate recent form are slight concerns
runners_data.comment: AW maiden winner; better form when third at Yarmouth last month; now makes handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Allowed to dictate at steady pace when winning Newcastle maiden (1m, AW) on debut in February and showed better form when third of six behind useful rival at Yarmouth (1m, good) last month; probably needs to take another step forward on this handicap debut but remains unexposed.

runners_data.name: Seu Jo
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with French form translating, though British debut and tough assignment present questions
runners_data.comment: Won 1m AW claimer on last of six starts in France; makes British debut today
runners_data.spotlight: 1-6 when based in France, signing off with win in 1m AW claimer in March; still unexposed over this trip but this looks a fairly tough assignment on British debut.

runners_data.name: Exotic Baby
runners_data.note: Hold-up type recently gelded which could aid focus, drops back from 1m2f seasonal debut
runners_data.comment: Safely held in both handicaps; drops back in trip and tries cheekpices on turf debut
runners_data.spotlight: Won 1m AW maiden in September but safely held in both handicaps, latterly when upped to 1m2f for seasonal debut in March; subsequently gelded and now drops back in trip and sports new cheekpieces for turf debut.

runners_data.name: Luzon Heights
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who ran well fresh at Newmarket last time, significantly dropped in the weights
runners_data.comment: Gained only win in run-of-the-mill AW nursery but ran well on last month's seasonal debut
runners_data.spotlight: Gained only win from seven starts in a run-of-the-mill AW nursery but was close up in fifth on last month's seasonal debut at Newmarket (1m, good), and is closely matched with Blue Courvoisier and Arbaawy on that form.

runners_data.name: King's Trust
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from 204-day break for top connections, headgear change suggests readiness
runners_data.comment: Won five-runner AW maiden in October and can improve again in handicaps this year
runners_data.spotlight: Delivered on earlier promise when winning five-runner Southwell maiden (7f, AW; first-time blinkers) in October, his third start; contests much deeper race here but still has potential; cheekpieces tried today.

runners_data.name: Arbaawy
runners_data.note: Front-runner who finished close to Blue Courvoisier last time, consistent maiden looking for breakthrough
runners_data.comment: 0-7 now but was close fourth in good Newmarket handicap on last month's reappearance
runners_data.spotlight: A maiden after seven starts but only beaten about 1l when running-on fourth (just behind Blue Courvoisier) on last month's seasonal/handicap debut at Newmarket; no surprise if he's on the premises again.

runners_data.name: Tiger Power
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with mixed recent form, visor first time suggests tactical adjustment needed
runners_data.comment: Won two of first three starts but ran poorly on handicap debut; visor now added
runners_data.spotlight: Defied a penalty when winning Southwell novice (1m, AW) on seasonal debut in February but ran poorly when switched to a handicap at Newmarket (1m, good) last month; needs new visor to help him rebound.

runners_data.name: Peel Park
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid course form, 21 days off ideal for Varian stable

runners_data.name: Raging Raj
runners_data.note: Prominent racer dropping from stronger Newmarket contest, dual AW winner looking to translate to turf
runners_data.comment: Last month's Newmarket run was very respectable but he's more exposed than some of these
runners_data.spotlight: Won two AW nurseries in November (1m/7f) and was very respectable seventh in good Newmarket handicap (1m, good) contested by a few of these last month but might be vulnerable to less-exposed rivals again.

runners_data.name: Northern Empire
runners_data.note: Natural leader who will ensure strong pace, 35-day break allows for needed freshening

races.paceDynamic: Outback Heat, Northern Empire and Arbaawy will ensure a strong early gallop over this 1m trip at Ascot. All three have natural pace and the inclination to lead, creating genuine pressure from the outset. The sustained tempo will stretch the field and test stamina reserves in the final two furlongs. This setup strongly favours prominent racers and hold-up horses with proven staying power, while pure speed horses and those needing soft leads will struggle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Sustained
scenarios.trigger: If all three pace-setters maintain their positions through halfway
scenarios.body: The relentless tempo will find out the stamina-shy and set up a finish for horses with tactical speed from off the pace. Hold-up horses like Spirit Of Saxony and Seu Jo can unleash finishing kicks while prominent racers with proven stamina like Blue Courvoisier can stay in touch throughout.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If one or more front-runners drops back early leaving a softer tempo
scenarios.body: The race becomes more tactical allowing horses needing easier conditions to compete, but those with natural acceleration still hold the edge. King's Trust and Tiger Power can benefit from the steadier rhythm while late closers still get their chance.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Outback Heat or Northern Empire can dictate terms and soften the pace
scenarios.body: The leader gets an easier time of it and can potentially stay on, though this still sets up chances for closers with the tactical pace. Outback Heat has shown he can control races while Blue Courvoisier has the class to respond.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the three pace-setters engage in a speed duel through the early stages
scenarios.body: All three front-runners compromise each other allowing a horse from further back to capitalize on their tactical positioning. The race becomes a pure staying test favouring the strongest finishers.

watchPoints.text: Outback Heat and Northern Empire could engage too early and set up the race for closers completely
Blue Courvoisier's tendency to race freely could see him involved in the pace battle despite his class
King's Trust returning from 204-day absence may need the run despite strong stable booking of Buick
Spirit Of Saxony has shown clear promise in maidens and this stronger pace should suit his style perfectly
Luzon Heights has dropped significantly in the weights and ran well fresh at Newmarket last month

races.name: Peroni Nastro Azzurro 0.0% Apprentice Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Galactic Charm
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning from hurdling with 562 days off the Flat, distance suits but fitness a major concern
runners_data.comment: Regressive over hurdles last term but mark fine if this return to the Flat perks him up
runners_data.spotlight: In decent form when last seen on the Flat for Michael Bell but has been hurdling since December 2024 for this yard; did well as a juvenile in that sphere but last season didn't go well; mark fine if this return to the Flat perks him up.

runners_data.name: Naval Tribute
runners_data.note: Strong hold-up horse who won last time at Kempton, prefers longer trips but drawn wide may hinder late challenge
runners_data.comment: 2-3 since handicapping up in trip in headgear; now tackles 2m and it could unlock more
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten a nose, a head and a neck in three bumpers; earned his mark over 1m and predictably did better upped in trip when scoring at Kempton (1m3f, AW; first-time cheekpieces) in March; rebounded from a blip next time when going in again at Beverley (1m4f, good to firm; first-time visor) a fortnight ago; dam half-sister to St Leger winner Brian Boru and this new trip could unlock more again; key player.

runners_data.name: Expressionless
runners_data.note: Proven at extended distances with good turf form, hold-up style suits but needs everything to drop right
runners_data.comment: Has won at 1m6f; scored over 1m4f (good) latest; mark fine and 2m worth a go; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Three wins at 1m6f and it was his sixth win in total when beating four others over 1m4f at Leicester (good) last month; has won off this mark before and 2m looks worth a go; respected.

runners_data.name: Circuit Breaker
runners_data.note: Only prominent runner who can track Calvert, recent AW form solid and trip/going ideal
runners_data.comment: Good third in competitive event (2m, AW) latest; turf no issue; can give a good account
runners_data.spotlight: Can set the pace; twice runner-up at Wolverhampton (1m6f/16.5f) during the winter and a good third of 14 in competitive event at Lingfield (2m, also AW; Tarbat Ness sixth) on Good Friday; turf no problem and he should give a good account.

runners_data.name: Educator
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with turf wins, good recent third at Bath over similar trip suggests well-handicapped
runners_data.comment: Respectable third (2m1f) back from two-month break last time; might build on that
runners_data.spotlight: Three wins on turf (good/good to firm) at up to 11.5f; also went fairly close at this trip on AW in January; respectable third at Bath (2m1f, good to firm; Lusaka second) on return from two-month break last time; might build on that.

runners_data.name: Tarbat Ness
runners_data.note: Specialist 2m winner with soft going form, hold-up style and stamina proven at this distance
runners_data.comment: All five wins at 2m; latest fourth (2m, good) was close to his best; can't be ruled out
runners_data.spotlight: All five wins at 2m, including three on soft going, latterly at Catterick in October; went back-to-back at Newcastle (AW) at the start of the year and fourth at Ripon (2m, good) on latest outing was close to his best; same mark, so needs to find extra, but he can't be ruled out.

runners_data.name: Believitanducan
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning from hurdling after 382 days, class evident but fitness uncertain
runners_data.comment: Sole Flat start for yard when second (2m, AW) in April 2025; has won over hurdles since
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in all four staying handicaps (includes 2m win) for Jessica Macey in 2024; three hurdle wins since joining this yard and a good effort on the Flat when second at Kempton (2m, AW) in April 2025; respected on his return to this sphere.

runners_data.name: Calvert
runners_data.note: Sole front-runner gets tactical advantage, recent seconds at 2m show stamina and Taryn Langley takes 3lb off
runners_data.comment: Went very close (1m6f, AW) in March; strike-rate a negative but he has ability to figure
runners_data.spotlight: Sole success came when evens for a Bath novice (1m2f, good to soft) as 2yo; respectable efforts across five starts at 1m6f and 2m in 2025 and he went mighty close at Wolverhampton (1m6f, AW) in March after which he had a run over hurdles; strike-rate isn't a positive but he has the ability to figure.

runners_data.name: Aajej
runners_data.note: Inconsistent prominent/midfield runner, unproven at 2m on turf but won last start after long break
runners_data.comment: Sold for 31,000gns after winning last time; turf and 2m are queries; first cheekpieces
runners_data.spotlight: Unplaced both turf starts and both 2m races; inconsistent on AW but took advantage of career-low mark to score by a neck over 1m6f in January on final start for the Crisfords; sported first-time blinkers that day and sold for 31,000gns the following month; cheekpieces are today's headgear and he has something to prove back on turf at 2m.

runners_data.name: Gemmari
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with AW-only experience, flopped badly when tried at 2m previously at Chelmsford
runners_data.comment: Let favourite backers down either side of 1m6f AW win in January; 2m a query; turf debut
runners_data.spotlight: All starts on AW; sole start at 2m resulted in short-priced flop at Chelmsford in November; won at that track (1m6f) next time but he let favourite backers down again when beating one home over that trip at Wolverhampton in March; 1m4f caught him out last time but others look safer.

runners_data.name: Francesco Baracca
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with better AW form, recent Newbury third over 2m on turf shows potential
runners_data.comment: Best effort on turf when plugging-on third last time (2m, good); each-way shout
runners_data.spotlight: Best form on AW but has won on turf and it was his best effort on grass when third of six at Newbury (2m, good; plugged on) three weeks ago; each-way shout.

runners_data.name: Lusaka
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who can make running, proven 2m winner but veteran needs everything to fall right
runners_data.comment: Fair go from the front when second (2m1f) last time; same mark and he's not dismissed
runners_data.spotlight: Scored for the sixth time when making all at Newbury (13.5f, good to firm) off 1lb lower in July and gave it a fair go from the front when second at Bath (2m1f, good to firm; Educator third) three weeks ago; same mark and should make his presence felt.

runners_data.name: Wise Counsellor
runners_data.comment: Has struggled over hurdles for current stable; makes limited appeal on Flat return
runners_data.spotlight: 11-race maiden; left Andrew Balding after running poorly in a seller in September and showed no significant promise in three subsequent hurdle races for new stable.

races.paceDynamic: Calvert is the sole confirmed front-runner and will lead from the start, setting a sustainable pace without pressure from the large field of hold-up horses. Circuit Breaker may track closely as the only prominent runner, but the majority including Naval Tribute, Expressionless, Educator, and Francesco Baracca will settle towards the rear. This creates a classic scenario where the pace-setter gets an easy lead before the field closes late over the extended trip. The race shape heavily favours front-runners and prominent racers who can exploit the uncontested early fractions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Calvert Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Calvert gets his own way in front and sustains his gallop
scenarios.body: The leader maintains his advantage as the field struggles to close the gap having given him too much rope early. His recent close seconds at 2m show he can handle this trip when getting a soft lead.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses time their runs perfectly and Calvert weakens
scenarios.body: The favourite types coordinate their challenge in the final half-mile as the front-runner pays for his early freedom. Class tells as the better-rated horses sweep past.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Compromise Victory
scenarios.trigger: If Circuit Breaker applies early pressure or tracks closer than expected
scenarios.body: The race develops into more honest fractions which suits the prominent runner who can quicken off a stronger pace. Mid-division horses benefit from the truer tempo.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock Outsider Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites fail to handle the step up in trip or going conditions
scenarios.body: An unfancied stayer with proven stamina exploits the tactical nature while the market leaders disappoint. Previous 2m form becomes crucial.

watchPoints.text: Calvert must be watched for early pace - if he gets an uncontested lead the race becomes his to lose
Circuit Breaker's positioning crucial as only horse likely to track the leader closely from the start
Naval Tribute and Expressionless need monitoring for their final furlong kick as the main market fancies
Weather conditions on the day could change the going and significantly impact the pace dynamics
Any late market moves on Tarbat Ness or Lusaka could signal stable confidence in their stamina edge
